transcript: First day at Meridian today, new team, new project, genuinely different energy in the room than Atlas ever had, less fire-fighting, more actual planning. Overwhelmed in the normal new-job way, learning everyone's names, where things live, but a good kind of overwhelmed, not the exhausted kind. Optimistic about this.

Lonely Saturday morning, first weekend properly alone since the breakup really settled in. Almost reached for my phone to send Sam something funny I saw, old habit not caught up with the new reality yet. Didn't send it. Just sat with the missing for a while instead, which felt like the more honest thing to do.

Apartment hunting officially started today, browsed listings for a couple hours, everything either too expensive or too far or somehow both. Overwhelming honestly. Going to schedule some actual viewings this week instead of just endlessly scrolling.
Quiet day, nothing much happening. Work fine, dinner simple, early night.

First Mother's Day without Nonna in the picture at all, and it hit differently than I expected, quieter than the sharper grief of February but somehow just as present. Called Mom this morning, she was okay, better than I feared honestly, we talked mostly about Nonna's sauce recipe, Mom finally sharing the actual written card with me over the phone, reading it out loud while I copied it down. Small thing, a recipe on a card, but it felt like something being passed forward instead of just lost. Quiet day otherwise, didn't do much, just let it be a smaller day.

Back to the regular week after yesterday's quieter Mother's Day. Work at Meridian continuing to feel genuinely good, actually contributing meaningfully to a design review today instead of just surviving another status meeting. Small steady good day.

Run this morning, half marathon training officially underway now, working up the distance slowly and carefully this time, learned my lesson from the knee scare back in March. Legs felt strong today. Spring properly here now, warm mornings, light lingering.

Reflex tonight to text Sam a joke I saw online, the specific kind of thing we used to send each other constantly, and this time I actually let myself feel the loss of that instead of pushing it away. It's a strange grief, missing the small daily texture of someone more than any single big thing. Didn't send it, obviously, but let myself sit with wanting to for a minute before moving on.

Pottery Thursday, good session, the class has become such a fixture at this point it barely feels like a decision anymore, just a standing appointment with myself. Made a set of small bowls, thinking about giving one to Mom next time I visit, something with Nonna in mind even if unspoken.

First apartment viewing today, place was fine, nothing special, a little dark and smaller than my current spot, but at least now I have a reference point for what's actually out there. Two more viewings scheduled for the weekend. The hunt continues.

Longer training run this morning, distance creeping up steadily, felt good and controlled, none of the reckless pace-pushing that got me hurt back in March. Learning to trust the slow build this time. Warm out already even in the early morning, real summer creeping into the edges of spring.

Second apartment viewing today, a little better than yesterday's, decent light, closer to the trail I usually run on. Still not quite right but getting a clearer sense of what I actually want now that I've seen a few options.

Helped Dario move apartments today, first time doing something this ordinary together since everything reopened between us, no big emotional conversation needed, just boxes and a couch that barely fit through his new door and pizza eaten sitting on unpacked crates afterward because neither of us wanted to look for plates yet. There was a moment carrying a particularly awkward dresser down two flights of stairs, both of us cursing and laughing at the same time, where it just felt easy between us, genuinely easy, maybe for the first time since he called back in March. Not talking about the past, not performing reconciliation, just two brothers moving furniture badly together. I think this is actually how it heals, in the boring ordinary moments more than the big ones.

Sore from yesterday's moving, whole body reminding me that carrying furniture down stairs is its own kind of workout. Good sore though, the kind that comes with a good memory attached to it. Quiet Sunday otherwise, recovering.

Mundane Monday at Meridian, nothing dramatic, steady work, still enjoying the change of pace from Atlas honestly, doesn't feel old yet. Apartment hunt on pause for a couple days while I catch my breath from the move-helping weekend.

Strange relief tonight, realized I hadn't thought about Sam even once today until just now writing this, and there's a complicated feeling in that, relief at not hurting as sharply mixed with a small guilt about the relief itself, like moving on too easily says something about how much it mattered in the first place. It mattered. I know it mattered. Healing just isn't linear or particularly polite about timing.

Pottery Thursday, race is in a few days now, half marathon nerves starting to creep into everything including tonight's session, kept second-guessing my hand placement more than usual. Made something serviceable but nothing special. Mind clearly elsewhere.

Third apartment viewing, this one's actually promising, good light, reasonable rent, close enough to Meridian's office and the trail both. Going to think on it over the weekend but leaning toward putting in an application. Race is Sunday, tapering the running down this week per the training plan, feels strange to rest this close to it after weeks of building up.

Pre-race nerves properly setting in now, laid out gear tonight the same ritual as before the ten k back in January, except this feels bigger, thirteen miles instead of six, a whole different category of effort. Texted Maya and Tom to confirm they're still coming to cheer, they are, that helps steady the nerves a little knowing there'll be familiar faces at the finish.

Half marathon done. Two hours and seven minutes, way past what I imagined possible for myself back in November doing that first out-of-breath mile and a half. Mile ten was brutal, the wall everyone warns you about, legs suddenly feeling like they belonged to someone else, every part of me wanting to stop and walk the rest. Pushed through it anyway, don't fully know how except that stopping felt worse somehow than the pain of continuing. Heard Maya and Tom before I saw them, screaming my name from somewhere in the crowd near mile twelve, exactly the boost I needed for that last brutal stretch. Crossing the finish line I had this unexpected thought of Nonna, just a flash of her, no specific reason, maybe just that big emotional moments seem to summon the people who aren't here to see them. Wish she could have seen this. I think she would have liked it, would have fed the whole finish-line crowd afterward given half a chance. Proud of myself today in a way that feels earned, built slowly over seven months of actually showing up.

Entire body sore today, stairs are an ordeal, but a satisfied kind of sore. Rested most of the day, relived bits of yesterday's race in my head more than once. Applied for that apartment from the viewing earlier this week too, fingers crossed on that front now.

Mundane Tuesday, back to work after the race weekend, everyone at Meridian asking about it since I hadn't shut up about training for weeks apparently. Nice to have people actually interested. Still no word on the apartment application.

Easy recovery run this morning, nothing pushed, just wanted to keep the legs moving a little after last weekend's half marathon without overdoing it. Warm already even this early, summer really settling in now. Nice quiet way to start the day before the apartment-application waiting game resumes.

Got approved for the apartment. Relief, genuine relief, one big open question in my life finally closing instead of piling on top of everything else. Move-in date works out fine with the end-of-June deadline, some breathing room instead of a mad scramble at the last minute. Small good thing to end the week on.

Pottery Thursday, calmer session now that both the race and the apartment question are resolved, more headspace to actually focus on the clay instead of everything else swirling. Started thinking about how I'm going to pack up all these pieces I've made over the past five months for the move, apparently accumulated more than I realized.

Quiet gratitude tonight, sitting with how far this year has come honestly, thinking briefly about Sam without the sharp ache of a few weeks ago, more just a soft appreciation for what was good about it while it lasted. Not everything has to end in bitterness to still be worth having happened.

Weekend errands, started boxing up the apartment for real now with the move less than three weeks out. Amazing how much stuff accumulates without you noticing. Dario's coming to help this time, nice that it's his turn to return the favor.

Month's ending, and looking back it's been a genuinely full one, Meridian starting well, the half marathon, Dario's move and now mine coming up, the Mother's Day quiet grief, Sam fading into something softer than the sharp early ache. A lot of change packed into thirty one days. Heading into June with an actual move on the calendar, nervous about the logistics but not about much else these days, which feels like real progress from where January started.
